summary: Apple co-founder Steve Jobs cheated his partners, denied fathering his daughter Lisa to dodge support, and built a secretive, disposable-product model resting on abusive Chinese factory labor, then died in 2011 after delaying cancer surgery for a fruit diet.

evidence.note: birth in February 1955 and adoption by Paul and Clara Jobs
adopts the fruitarian, mucus-free diet of naturopath Arnold Ehret in college
extended trip to India, Kumbh Mela, and his later claims about Indian intuition
California pursues him for child support after Lisa's mother goes on welfare; paternity test
Lisa's account of his cruel behaviour during visits when she was a child
failed boardroom move against Sculley, ouster from Apple, founding of NeXT
start of long segment on Apple's Chinese supplier factories
wave of worker suicides at Foxconn factory towns
dispatch labor abuses lead to a 2014 Chinese rule; Apple-commissioned supplier study
2003 pancreatic cancer diagnosis and months of diet treatment instead of surgery
liver transplant obtained ahead of others, decline and 2011 death

notes: covered_span ends in 2014 for the Chinese dispatch-labor rule and supplier study that the story ties to Apple's release cadence. child-abuse reflects his years-long denial and emotional cruelty toward his minor daughter Lisa, not physical abuse. Scope set global for the consumer-electronics legacy argument; international would also be defensible.
